snippet.title: Twilight Requiem: Gameplay Trailer (Dark Fantasy RPG)
snippet.description:
Twilight Requiem: Gameplay Trailer (Dark Fantasy RPG)

Wishlist on Steam! : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3830080/Twilight_Requiem/?beta=0

Welcome to the official Twilight Requiem YouTube channel! Dive into our indie game dev journey as we craft a dark fantasy action RPG blending Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix's fluid, combo-driven combat with Elden Ring's atmospheric, lore-rich worlds. Follow Casia, a celestial warrior with no memory, as she battles corrupted demi-gods and uncovers secrets of a fallen empire. "This is the first gameplay trailer teaser!". Join us for dev logs, behind-the-scenes, and updates on our upcoming Steam demo! 🌌 Subscribe, join our Discord, and grab exclusive merch!

🔗 Website: https://twilightrequiem.dev 🛒 Merch: https://twilightrequiem-shop.fourthwall.com 📱 Discord: https://discord.gg/WAu9b3Sqwh #IndieGame #GameDev #TwilightRequiem #ActionRPG #Steam #Unity6 #DarkFantasyRPG #IndieRPG
